faqs.q: Sec. 94-33. - Notice to owner to repair curb, gutter and sidewalks; service.
faqs.a:
When any curb, gutter and sidewalk in the front, side or rear of any premises in the
               city shall be in need of repair or reconstruction, the city manager, or his designee,
               shall cause notice in writing to be served upon the owner of such premises or the
               agent of the owner to repair or reconstruct the same within 30 days or an extended
               period at the discretion of the city manager or his designee. Service of notice may
               be completed by registered or certified United States mail, or personal delivery of
               the notice.
(
Ord. No. 4365, § 1, 11-19-2012
)
